title: Receipt v1: attested verification outcome
description: A signed statement of what was checked, on which build, under which policy, and what the decision was. Verification uses a trust store of issuer public keys; a key carried only inside the receipt is never trusted. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); duplicate keys and non-finite numbers are rejected. In CI, issuer identity can instead come from an attestation pinned to the repository and signing workflow. A carried key alone is never an issuer identity.

issuerKeyId.description: Identifier of the issuer key in the trust store.

repository.description: OWNER/NAME of the repository the receipt is about.

baseSha256.description: Recorded CI producer: SHA-256 of the lowercase ASCII Git base commit ID.

headSha256.description: Recorded CI producer: SHA-256 of the lowercase ASCII Git head commit ID.

buildSha256.description: Digest of the build that was exercised.

policySha256.description: Recorded CI producer: canonical digest of its pinned base, captured checks digest, both-observer rule, required sandbox and recorded-vision profile; see docs/ci-gate.md.

routeSetSha256.description: Recorded CI producer: canonical digest of the public route-name to route-SHA-256 mapping.

artifacts.description: Named digests of every evidence artifact. Recorded CI names capture.zip and regular files under report/ relative to the evidence root; its end-to-end checker hashes each one and refuses unsafe paths.

required.description: At least one required check. An empty list is not clearance.

issuedAt.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (Z or +hh:mm). The writer refuses any other form.

expiresAt.description: No later than 7 days after issuedAt. A longer span is not clearance.

publicKey.description: Canonical base64 of the issuer's raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key. Present for identification only; never trusted by itself.

signature.description: Canonical base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical receipt with the signature field omitted. One spelling only: padded, no other characters, unused bits zero.
